dimensions.note: No credentials are accepted, logged, or persisted.
Both methods emit structured entry and completion logs without payloads.
Strict input, evidence, prompt, output, invocation, and claim checks all precede persistence.
Tests cover configured policy, provenance, freshness, labels, blockers, missing data, strictness, prompt/output tampering, failed invocation, determinism, and no workspace side effect.
Methods are deterministic validation and persistence transformations with stable spec-prefixed instance names.
The extension performs no HTTP or provider invocation.
No network connection, file handle, workspace, or temporary resource is created.
Published docs and fixtures contain only synthetic example.test identifiers.
All public, nested, invocation, and persisted Zod object contracts are strict.
Both resource specs declare infinite lifetime and bounded GC retention.
This is a read-only assessment pipeline, not an external resource lifecycle.
request and validatedGate use distinct spec-prefixed instance names; each spec has one conforming writer.
